name: CopyCellsFromExcelWorksheet
label: Copy Cells from Excel Worksheet
description: Copies a specified range of cells from an Excel worksheet for later use or pasting into another worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object from which to copy data.

fields.name: CopyMode
fields.label: Copy Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to copy cells: Single Cell, Named Cells, Selection, or Range of Cells.

selectOptions.label: Single Cell
selectOptions.description: Copies a specific cell by column and row.

fields.name: SourceRangeAddress
fields.label: Source Range Address
fields.description: The range address (e.g., 'A1:B10') in the source worksheet to copy.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to copy.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to copy.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to copy.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to copy.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to copy.
